purpose: Measure semantic drift between the current product CombatManager vocabulary and BJJGraphReducerV2 before any authority migration.

PLAYER_TOP_CLINCH.reason: Legacy clinch does not specify head/arm/tie topology.

PLAYER_BOTTOM_CLINCH.reason: Legacy clinch does not specify head/arm/tie topology.

PLAYER_TOP_GUARD.reason: Could represent closed guard top, half guard top or another guard engagement.

PLAYER_BOTTOM_GUARD.reason: Could represent closed/open/half guard bottom; do not guess.

PLAYER_BACK_ATTACK.reason: Seatbelt does not itself imply scoring hooks/body triangle.

PLAYER_SUBMISSION_ATTACK.reason: Submission family and control topology are missing.

PLAYER_SUBMISSION_DEFENSE.reason: Submission family and escape hierarchy are missing.

baiana.known_delta: Legacy destination collapses guard topology; canonical slice establishes top half guard after the takedown.

sprawl.known_delta: Canonical counter includes successful front-headlock establishment; legacy Sprawl returns neutral and loses the control outcome.

puxada_guarda.known_delta: Legacy bottom-guard state is broader than the canonical closed-guard result.

promotion_requirements: Every live P1 legacy action has an authoritative canonical edge or an explicit deprecation path.
Every live legacy state has an unambiguous canonical representation or is replaced by richer state.
Legacy and reducer deterministic replay comparison has zero unexplained divergence.
Rules/scoring parity is proven for the selected ruleset.
CombatManager delegates outcome authority through an adapter without duplicating managers.
Full Godot and Android regression gates are green.
